name: Slackify Note (fork)
description: Fork of Slackify Note by Jeremy Overman. Adds an ampersand fix: slackify-markdown escapes & to & for Slack's API, which shows up literally when pasting into the Slack composer, so this decodes it back. < and > escaping is retained for Slack link/mention syntax.
author: Jeremy Overman (fork: Jim Carroll)
